[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]batch.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-cli--beads/blob/main/pages/bob-cli-bk/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Detect inbox route candidates and refuse without a choice[/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]route-detect[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]route-detect: bob capture finds existing inbox tasks whose checkbox the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]batch changes, reports them with route destinations in `inbox_route`, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and refuses write-free under hidden `--require-inbox-route-choice`.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Apply inbox route answers inside the capture batch[/bold #D7AFFF]            [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]route-apply[dim] · [dim][/dim]after route-detect[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]route-apply: `-i/--inbox-route` answers move candidates through the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]task-move engine inside the same capture batch, with freshness stamps, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]link repair, refusals, followed mirrors, and docs.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Decode inbox routes and send route answers in CaptureCore[/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]mac-route-client[dim] · [dim][/dim]after route-apply[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]mac-route-client: CaptureCore decodes `inbox_route`, sends answers and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the guard flag behind a per-identity capability, models the route choice[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]state, and documents the protocol.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Route card in the Bob Mac Capture panel[/bold #D7AFFF]                       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]mac-route-card[dim] · [dim][/dim]after mac-route-client[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]mac-route-card: the panel shows the route card on Return after any [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]pull-in card, resubmits the answers, handles refusals, documents the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]card, and lands the memory updates.[/#D7D7AF]
